text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH KV_ARENA fragmentation spike detected on prod-gpu-pool-3. Memory used growing rapidly, eviction rates soaring. Trigger: kv_arena_fragmentation > 70% for 3m on >= 6 nodes. Pager severity: P1. @alex_oncall paged.

alex_oncall: I'm seeing the alert, joining. Can someone post the top nodes?

kim_sre: node list in the alert: gpu-03a, gpu-03b, gpu-03c, gpu-04a, gpu-05b, gpu-05c. Eviction rate jumped ~4x at 17:03 UTC.

priya_eng-allocator: adding telemetry dump from gpu-03a:```
kv_arena_total: 412GB
kv_arena_live: 88GB
kv_arena_free: 6GB
fragmentation_ratio: 0.79
continuous_batch_inflight: 240
max_kv_entry: 52MB
malloc_failures: 0
```

mateo_runtime: interesting — malloc failures are 0, but we have runaway fragmentation. Could be freelist scattering after recent allocator change (PR #4321).

alex_oncall: Customer impact? Any 5xxs reported? @jen_csm pls check support tickets.

jen_csm: Early reports: 3 customers on Dedicated saw increased tail latency for generate endpoints, some requests timed out and retried, a few 503s surfaced ~17:05-17:12 UTC. I'm opening tickets and pinging their contacts.

kim_sre: Correlating with rollout timeline: PR #4321 (allocator slab splitting) merged yesterday. We suspected perf wins but could introduce internal fragmentation.

priya_eng-allocator: Reproduced locally with a load replay — fragmentation climbs when continuous batching overhead + heterogeneous KV sizes. Suspect batch coalescing plus slab split leads to many small free segments.

alex_oncall: Immediate mitigation idea: disable continuous batching on affected pool to reduce KV pressure and allow normal eviction to keep arena compact. Can we flip flag via runtime?

mateo_runtime: Yes: toggle CONT_BATCHER_ENABLED=false on pool config. Doing a rolling flag flip on gpu-03* now (one node at a time).

incident-bot: action_taken: toggled CONT_BATCHER_ENABLED=false on gpu-03a -> gpu-03c (3 nodes).

kim_sre: After gpu-03a flip: fragmentation dropped from 0.79 -> 0.58 in ~90s, eviction rate normalized. Continuing with b/c nodes.

priya_eng-allocator: While we roll, pushing a small hotfix to runtime to cap max_kv_batch_size to 128 and enable eager compaction on free > 64MB holes (safe flag gate). Patch:```diff
+ if (free_hole.size >= 64MB) compact_into_hole(free_hole);
+ max_kv_batch_size = min(config.batch_max, 128);
```

alex_oncall: Can you canary that on gpu-04a? I can divert a small percentage of traffic.

mateo_runtime: Canary applied to gpu-04a (5% traffic). Monitoring.

priya_eng-allocator: Canary metrics: fragmentation flattening on 04a within 3m. No regressions in latency. Pushing patch to hotfix branch and will roll to remaining pools after approval.

jen_csm: Customer updates: told affected customers we have identified allocator fragmentation regression tied to recent slab change. Short-term mitigation applied; continuous batching disabled on their pools. They'll keep monitoring.

kim_sre: Note: we observed that the allocator's arena compaction path was stalling when batch coalescer held long-lived KV references. Need follow-up to ensure compaction cannot be starved by inflight batches.

alex_oncall: On-call handoff: I'm staying on pager until full roll. @kim_sre & @priya_eng-allocator are primary for root-cause. I'll switch to monitoring duty at 18:15 UTC unless anything spikes.

incident-bot: timeline note: mitigation applied 17:07-17:15 UTC; canary hotfix deployed 17:28 UTC.

priya_eng-allocator: Root cause provisional: PR #4321 changed slab allocation granularity and introduced slower coalescing for freed KV segments. Under continuous batching, many freed segments become too fragmented before compaction runs. This produced high fragmentation ratios causing internal OOM-like behavior (evictions and timeouts).

mateo_runtime: Short-term follow-ups (today):
- revert PR #4321 on affected runtime branches if hotfix fails quickly
- add a compaction watchdog to force periodic merges even with inflight batches
- add metrics for freelist scatter and large-hole counts

kim_sre: Longer-term: allocator redesign to avoid fragmentation cliff with a mixed-size workload. Evaluate slab pooling thresholds and per-size class compaction. Also add auto-threshold to disable continuous batching when fragmentation > 0.6.

alex_oncall: Any blockers for rolling the hotfix to all pools? Security/QA?

priya_eng-allocator: Hotfix branch passes internal tests. Need one more sign-off from runtime (mateo) and eng-sre (kim) before broad roll.

mateo_runtime: I approve. I'll coordinate the rolling deployment with hour-window and throttle concurrency to 2 nodes at a time.

incident-bot: resolution_update: CONT_BATCHER toggled off on impacted pools; hotfix rolled to all GPU pools by 17:54 UTC. Fragmentation metrics returned to baseline (~0.25-0.35). Customer errors subsided.

jen_csm: Follow-up emails sent to affected customers with mitigation summary and ETA for permanent fix. One customer wants offline review — scheduled for tomorrow.

alex_oncall: Closing pager once metrics stable for 30m post-roll. Leaving a postmortem ticket: PM-411. Assigning owners: priya (RCA + patch), kim (monitoring + runbook), mateo (runtime rollout + compaction watchdog).

priya_eng-allocator: Prelim postmortem notes: PR #4321 interaction with continuous batching not stress-tested. Will add replay tests with mixed KV sizes and enable fragmentation stress suites in CI.

kim_sre: Runbook additions: add a diagnostic: `kv_arena_free_holes > 10 && fragmentation_ratio > 0.6` to trigger auto-mitigation (disable batching & throttle).

incident-bot: incident_state: mitigated; further RCA work scheduled.

alex_oncall: Thanks everyone — good coordination. I'll post a short summary in #postmortems and link PM-411 once fleshed out. :thumbsup:
